# Vendored DTCG 2025.10 JSON Schemas

`format.json` and `resolver.json` are the Design Tokens Community Group's
published 2025.10 schema bundles, copied byte-for-byte so validation runs
offline and cannot drift with the network:

| File | Source | SHA-256 as fetched (2026-09-26) |
|---|---|---|
| `format.json` | https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/format.json | `32e93b780e4e4bca778d0780cb797a560deedc470c608af16576223f7e42915f` |
| `resolver.json` | https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/resolver.json | `a5acd14318f3c347ea2d12b4ab0f873d1340e74e957c454d112672e58b1da977` |
